title: Ideate Weekly #1: Product Updates & GDC Recap!
summary: Check out the latest ideate.xyz product updates including multi-image upload, improved asset previews, texture layer controls, and our GDC 2025 experience.
body_markdown:
Hey Ideate Creators! Welcome to the very first edition of Ideate Weekly! 🎉


We're thrilled to launch this newsletter as your go-to source for all things ideate.xyz. Each week, we'll be diving into the latest product updates, sharing tips, highlighting community happenings (when available!), and giving you a sneak peek at what's coming next. Our goal is to keep you informed and help you get the most out of our creative suite.


Let's jump right into the exciting new features and improvements we've recently rolled out:
